label: default allow_false
source: {{ false | default: 'bar', allow_false:true }}

label: blank alias
source: {% assign x = blank %}{% if '' == x %}TRUE{% else %}FALSE{% endif %}

label: string last
source: {{ s.last }}

label: capture and reassignment
source: {% capture some %}hello{% endcapture %}{% assign other = some %}{% assign some = 'foo' %}{{ some }}-{{ other }}

label: increment visibility
source: {% increment foo %} {{ foo }}

label: forloop name
source: {% for tag in product.tags limit:1 %}{{ forloop.name }}{% endfor %}

label: capture whitespace
source: {% capture x %}  {% endcapture %}[{{ x }}]

label: nested comments
source: {% comment %}    {% comment %}    {% comment %}{%    endcomment     %}    {% endcomment %}{% endcomment %}

label: blank filter coercion
source: {{ blank | split: '' | join: '-' }}

label: tablerow break
source: {% tablerow n in (1..3) cols:2 %}{{n}}{% break %}{{n}}{% endtablerow %}

label: include outer scope
source: {% include 'outer-scope' %}

label: blank and empty expression literals
source: {% assign a = blank %}{% assign b = empty %}{{ a | append: 'x' }}|{{ b | append: 'y' }}|{{ blank_label }}

label: blank and empty equality across value types
source: {% for value in values %}{% if value == blank %}B{% else %}-{% endif %}{% if empty == value %}E{% else %}-{% endif %};{% endfor %}

label: assigned and quoted blank are ordinary values
source: {% assign a = blank %}{% assign b = empty %}{% if value == a or value == b or value == 'blank' %}ordinary{% elsif value == blank %}predicate{% endif %}{% unless value != blank %}!{% endunless %}

label: blank and empty case alternatives
source: {% case value %}{% when 'text' or empty %}empty{% when 'other', blank %}blank{% else %}other{% endcase %}

label: offset continue
source: {% for n in (1..5) limit:2 %}{{n}}{% endfor %}|{% for n in (1..5) offset:continue %}{{n}}{% endfor %}

label: reversed with limit and offset
source: {% for n in (1..5) offset:1 limit:2 reversed %}{{n}}{% endfor %}

label: reversed before options
source: {% for n in (1..5) reversed offset:1 limit:2 %}{{n}}{% endfor %}

label: forloop index after continue
source: {% for n in (1..3) %}{% if n == 2 %}{% continue %}{% endif %}{{n}}:{{forloop.index}};{% endfor %}

label: unless with else
source: {% unless enabled %}off{% else %}on{% endunless %}

label: unless with elsif
source: {% unless enabled %}off{% elsif ready %}ready{% else %}waiting{% endunless %}

label: mixed boolean operators
source: {% if a and b or c %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

label: nested unless uses the matching end tag
source: {% unless a %}{% unless b %}inner{% else %}inner else{% endunless %}{% else %}outer else{% endunless %}

label: offset continue shares state across conditional scopes
source: {% if true %}{% for n in (1..5) limit:2 %}{{n}}{% endfor %}{% endif %}|{% unless false %}{% for n in (1..5) offset:continue %}{{n}}{% endfor %}{% endunless %}
